Install MongoDB
Copy page

MongoDB is available in two server editions: Community and Enterprise.

NOTE
MongoDB Atlas

MongoDB Atlas is a hosted MongoDB service option in the cloud which requires no installation overhead and offers a free tier to get started.

This section contains information on installing MongoDB.

To upgrade your current deployment to MongoDB 7.0, see 7.0 Upgrade Procedures.

To upgrade to the latest patch release for your current version, see Upgrade to the Latest Self-Managed Patch Release of MongoDB.

For documentation of mongod, mongos, and all other tools distributed with MongoDB, see MongoDB Package Components.

MongoDB Installation Tutorials
NOTE

If you installed MongoDB using a package manager such as APT, DNF, or Zypper, use your operating system's package management tool to upgrade within Patch Releases. For Major and Rapid follow the installation instructions for your OS.
